description: B0 = SUMO defaults (PLAN Phase 2.1) written as a spec: one archetype per vTypeDistribution with no params and no TraCI rules, so every attribute keeps its SUMO vClass default (custom1 = moto_violator gets the motorcycle defaults and custom2 = car_violator the passenger defaults, as in the hand-written rules/compiled/B0/vtypes.add.xml). Compiling it gives the same vTypes as the hand-written file (tests/test_compiler.py::test_B0_spec_equivalent_to_handwritten); the hand-written file stays the one the runner uses.

driver_archetypes.rationale: SUMO motorcycle defaults on vClass custom1 (the only class allowed on the banned HDT_N and HDT_S left turns).
SUMO passenger defaults on vClass custom2 (with custom1 the only classes allowed straight from the continuous right-turn lane).
